away.summary: The Red Wings (7-8-3) are projected to start John Gibson in net after he missed two games with a lower-body injury. Detroit welcomes back forwards Mason Appleton and Marco Kasper, while Dylan Larkin is suspended and Carter Mazur is scratched. The team also assigned John Leonard, Nate Danielson, and goaltender Michal Postva to Grand Rapids.

returning: : Logan Mailloux (season debut after missing first 17 games with broken right hand)
home.summary: The Blues (7-8-2) are projected to start Joel Hofer in net. Logan Mailloux makes his season debut after missing the first 17 games with a broken right hand, while Calle Rosen was recalled from the AHL. Tyler Tucker (knee) and Dillon Dube (neck) remain injured, and Adam Jiricek and Theo Lindstein were assigned to Springfield.
